title: סט אייקוני RPG בסגנון החדש
note: this is the first exercise delivered entirely on the local box, with no cloud fallback. `flux1-kontext-dev` has appeared on the G5, which is one of the three unlocks ex-01 finding 15 said were needed, and it changes the answer to the question the package keeps asking.

title: סט אסימונים עגולים
note: production's own two value-bases share a rim at dE 0.0 because they share the pixels. Re-prompting that rim four times scored 47.0. Placing one approved base scored 0.1. The brief's "write a rim sentence and keep it identical" is the wrong tool for a geometric trait.

title: שלוש מסגרות קלף: פיראטים, ים, בישול
note: an empty-centre card is a sparse canvas, so the empty field, the band thickness and the four corners are placed pixels, not a repeated sentence. Re-prompting the centre empty is the analog of re-prompting the rim.

title: שחזור מסגרת מפרומפט קיים
note: a production prompt written for two other API refs will spend its IGNORE clauses on the only image you bind. Packed floral density is a starting latent, not a sentence.

title: מסגרת UI בסגנון RPG
note: the empty centre is a same-colour slate hole, not a cream card. Name that in the positive and Kontext leaves the hole empty on txt2img. A 10% rectangle punch then eats the gold rivets; flood the slate field instead.

title: שלושה גראונדים ממשפחה אחת
note: the family invariants that survive a new ingredient are the even wash and the wallpaper density. The two traits the sampler will not copy — dusty kitchen chroma on the word "honey", and the gold-amber pips — are shared pixels (finding 42), not another sentence.

title: רקע טבע עם גמדים
note: the scene that both styles will keep is a centred toadstool with a kettle on the cap and three hat-colours around the stem. Asking for a pour, a sun in the upper-left, and "no path" does not survive; asking for three gnomes around a centred mushroom drops a gnome on four of six seeds.

title: חוף עם ספינת פיראטים בארבעה סגנונות
note: v2 rewrote scene.txt (one ship, sails tied like bedrolls, no mountains) and swapped 01-toy-box for 09-soldiers-heroes. The sailing-ship prior still won. The four-up identity that survived is hull-left + sun-right + no people. Do not mix these 1344 winners with the v1 1536 G7 set.

title: טקסטורה להדפסה
note: even wash is a pixel lock, not a sentence. The denim product itself measures vig +16.4. Binding it copies the lighting dome. Flatten the ref, then flatten leather. Parchment copied "evenness" into a blank cream until a PIL rag-paper card was the bound image.

title: דמות מצילום: סגנון רנסנס
note: likeness survived when the graph contained only this woman (face crop + hair crop as `--style-ref`, txt2img from noise). Binding the dusty-trails oil people, or even headless cloth, plus the word "Renaissance", painted a porcelain Madonna. Img2img from the photo either froze the snapshot or ate the face.

title: דמות מצילום: סגנון סייברפאנק
note: finding 92 still holds on a male identity and an aggressive neon/chrome prior. Two crops of THIS photo, and nothing else, as `--style-ref`, txt2img from noise. Binding the sewing-machine card on a second pass did not steal the face (it is a machine, not a painted person) and also did not grow accessories.

title: אותה דמות, שתי פוזות
note: finding 92 still holds on a child identity and a full-body cel-shade prior. Two crops of THIS photo as `--style-ref` locked pose A. Pose B as txt2img from the approved anchor (not a light img2img of pose A, not the photo) grew a walk-and-wave while keeping face, hair, polo, and khaki.

title: הרצת web-kit מלאה
note: the painted Batya standee donates WHO across every five-slot seed. Taking her off the graph stops the clone, but the kit's "Female, older woman / בתיה המלכה" prior then paints a gray-haired queen instead of the kitchen man.

title: דמות מלאה בסגנון RPG
note: finding 92 still holds on this adult male photo. Two crops of THIS photo as `--style-ref` locked a full-body standee with both feet in frame. Gear as txt2img from that approved lock (finding 98) added cloak, leather, and a sword without replacing the face or cropping the feet. Named painterly RPG words, and later one item-only style sheet, did not outvote the lock's clean cartoon finish.

title: ממקום אמיתי לאיור: img2img
note: the shop photo as `--init-image` is the geometry lock (finding 89), but only while the wall pixels stay in the latent. Tiled boot-wall at denoise 0.75 stayed a photograph with Hebrew tags. A dark aisle cut-out plus the waterfall as `--style-ref` at 0.85 let seed 2202 paint an empty hiking shop (ottoman, helmets, ice axe, boot shelves, dusty aisle, no text). Seed 1101 kept the gray slab and leaked a pool.

title: אריח מיקום: בניין אמיתי כארט
note: the living-room photo as `--init-image` is the geometry lock. Denoise 0.78 kept a warm photograph. Cropping the poster strip / whiteboard / chrome jamb and raising denoise to 0.85 let seed 1101 paint this same sofa–table–lamp room in the series oil. Seed 2202 painted harder but moved the lamp. Seed 3303 donated a sideboard and a different floor plan.

title: סצנה נרטיבית מלאה
note: the filled master template on local Kontext locks a still poker table. Storm, flying cards, and open doors needed a second img2img pass from that composition lock. Extra doorway silhouettes are what "bursting through the doors" paints; they survived three denoise levels and a failed PIL tan fill.

title: גב קלף סימטרי
note: naming "perfect 180-degree rotational symmetry" still paints a point-up pentagram. The measured file is a PIL lock: keep the top half, `Image.rotate(180)`, blend the seam, stamp one 8-point star over the figure-8 core the seam left behind.

title: קלף מנה: ריבוי רפרנסים עם תפקידים
note: role-split + "IGNORE its food" held shakshuka (eggs in red sauce, no fish). Dry dishes painted a teal well and a mutated rim. Honey-cake seed 2202 cloned the bound hraymeh. Winners are a PIL plate lock: stamp food onto one empty house-plate PNG.

title: ארט קופסה בשכבות
note: empty upper-third of a packed town is an empty well (65, 135). Named keyed lime did not hold on B; a sky-field flood did. The same named lime *did* hold as a character studio field on C. Ellipse wash painted poster skies; impasto wash recovered oil.

title: סט חפצי RPG
note: one item-only loot crop is enough to lock a five-prop cartoon set. Words do not kill the style-ref's contact ellipse; PIL does. The key is the prop that tries to leave (charcoal, off-body sparkle, then a glowing bow, then a second object). Warm-brown metal plus a bow-hole punch pulled it back.
